subject: Bespoke bars and entertaining furniture
hook: Built into the alcove, or a freestanding drinks cabinet you can take with you?
ig:
Built into the alcove, or a freestanding drinks cabinet you can take with you?

We make both, and the choice usually comes down to how long you plan to stay.

A: Built-in bar
It uses every bit of the alcove or under-stairs space, floor to ceiling, scribed to the walls with no gaps for dust to collect. The trade-off: it belongs to the house, so if you move, it stays behind.

B: Freestanding drinks cabinet or sideboard
Made to your size, but it is a piece of furniture you can take with you, or move to another room when the layout changes. The trade-off: it leaves gaps at the sides and top, and usually offers less storage height than a fitted unit.

Forever home? Built-in tends to win. Likely to move in a few years? Freestanding keeps your options open.

Which would you choose, and why? Tell us in the comments.
